title: Song - O Come, O Come, Emmanuel
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
raisedBecause: Long runs of eighth notes in the melody, five and more in a row.
trains: A modal hymn tune in E minor over block chords (Em, Am, B, D) in the left.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1300-veni-emmanuel: "Veni Emmanuel" (hymn tune, "O Come, O Come, Emmanuel"), traditional, SATB; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1300)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1300), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
